meta.purpose: Design specification for the four anomalies deliberately built into the source data.
meta.status: Design artefact. Every observed figure below is reproduced by the SQL layer (sql/build.sql) and the band cleansing, so the answer key is verifiable from the repository itself.
meta.warning: Do not edit to make an analysis pass. This is the answer key against which detection precision and recall are measured.
meta.scoring: Each segment declares the rule that should fire on it, or null when no rule should. The prioritisation rule is specified in detection-rule.md and implemented as DAX measures; block 6 scores that implementation against this file and reports precision and recall.

replacement_factor.note: Declared assumption. Sensitivity tested at 1.0x / 1.5x / 2.0x on slide 11.

segments.name: Data & Analytics IC3-IC4 · Bogotá
segments.correct_action: Targeted salary adjustment for the segment
segments.description: Strong, consistent signal. Sustained pay drift: mean compa-ratio 0.85 with 86% of the segment below band minimum, and voluntary attrition at 2.6x the company baseline.

segments.name: Engineering IC5 · Dublin
segments.root_cause: Salary compression: recent hires paid above long-tenured incumbents
segments.correct_action: Internal equity adjustment for incumbents with 3+ years of tenure
segments.description: Invisible in the segment average, which sits at 0.99. A tenure-cohort cut shows incumbents with 3+ years at 0.912 against recent hires at 1.062 - a 15-point compression gap. Attrition has not reacted yet: an internal equity problem before it becomes a retention problem.

segments.name: Sales IC3-M1 · São Paulo
segments.root_cause: Pay mix: variable target well above market
segments.correct_action: None. Total target cash is in line with market.
segments.description: DESIGNED FALSE POSITIVE. Base compa-ratio 0.88, but a 41% variable target against a 25% market norm: total target cash lands at 0.99. Attrition is 15.8% against 16.4% for LATAM as a whole - below its own region, not above it. Only an analysis reading base salary in isolation would flag this as a priority.

segments.name: Risk & Compliance IC2 · Singapore
segments.root_cause: Excessive span of control (>12 direct reports)
segments.correct_action: Organisational intervention: add a supervisory layer
segments.description: SECOND DESIGNED DISTRACTOR. Attrition at 2.4x the baseline with a compa-ratio of 1.01 and only 4% of the segment below band. The cause is organisational, not financial: span of control of 15.1 against 6.7 across the rest of the company.

background_noise.note: Random compa-ratio deviation with no segment pattern. Must not produce any prioritised segment.
